difficulty_reason: Defines Inf_x(M) = Lift(id_x, A[M]) and T_x(M) = Lift(x, A[M]) and proves they are A-linear functors via (RS*) additivity; the action of T_x(I) on lifts comes from the isomorphism A' x_A A' -> A' x_A A[I] given by g(a_1,a_2) = a_1 + a_2 - a_1 (mod I), applied twice through (RS*); the difference maps satisfy the transitivity rule by commutativity of the triple-product diagram, yielding a free transitive action when lifts exist.
